Lifecycle Phase 08 of 10

Post-deployment Testing Support

Verification of system behavior in production.

Overview

The Post-deployment Testing Support phase verifies that the solution operates correctly within the production environment following release. Hardened Builds LLC confirms system behavior, validates monitoring, and coordinates resolution of any issues observed under live conditions.

Activities and Deliverables

  • Smoke testing of critical functionality in the production environment.
  • Validation that monitoring, logging, and alerting operate as designed.
  • Verification of system performance under live operating load.
  • Identification and coordinated resolution of issues observed in production.

Phase Specifics

  • Production smoke testing
  • Validation of monitoring and alerting
  • Performance verification under live load
  • Resolution of production-identified issues

Engagement

This phase is available as part of a complete lifecycle engagement or as a discrete service.
